items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee discusses Muddy Waters only in response to the interviewer's question about an anecdote involving Muddy Waters and Keith Richards. Ramsey Lewis does not claim any personal interaction, professional relationship, or direct knowledge of Muddy Waters beyond what was presented in the int

ctx.x: I don’t know what you mean, soured on it.

Some people – what I referenced earlier, that Muddy Waters was out there painting his house when – I think when Keith Richards came to visit. Come to Chess Records to pay homage. He comes by, and there’s Muddy Waters, painting. And the
assumption – you mentioned Sonny. Maybe that’s Sonny Boy Williamson, working the stockroom. So I don’t know. But perhaps you just shared . . .
